messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up: Aether Labs dedicated pool bring-up starts tomorrow 10:00 PT. Need final quota plan, autoscale policy, and load-test window. @raj_platform can you confirm pool size?

raj_platform: Confirmed pool=8xA4000, reserve 2 for burst; autoscale min=4 max=12. Will that cover their peak 300 TPS? Need profile.

elliot_oncall: 300 TPS looks high given seq len 512. Which model variant? quantized or FP16?

maya_cs: They will start with 'redwood/gpt-medium-1' quantized-8bit, expected avg seq=256 but storms go to 512. Renewal risk if latency > 200ms.

sophia_eng: We should set autoscale cooldown=45s, prefix cache enabled. Also recommend starting with burst+warmup script to prime KV cache.

maya_cs: Loading plan: 3 phases — smoke (10m), ramp (45m to 60% load), soak (1h at target). Need k6 script and runbook.

raj_platform: I'll upload k6 script to the runbook. k6 command below:
```bash
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 60m scripts/aether_convo.js --out json=out.json
```
Make sure API key uses dedicated creds.

deploy-bot: Reserved pool provisioning for aether-labs-dedicated completed (pool-id: rp-aether-01).

maya_cs: Thanks. One more: can we enable canary fallback to hosted small model if latency spikes? Customer wants graceful degradation.

sophia_eng: yes, routing policy ready — canary -> fp16 small model; fallback threshold 5% error rate or 350ms p95.

elliot_oncall: Ops note: monitor GPU memory churn, watch host OOM and nv_peer_mem logs. Add alert: 'aether.p95_latency > 350ms for 3m'

maya_cs: I'll capture feedback and send to CSMs post-soak. Also schedule 1:1 with customer Thurs 14:00 PT to review SLA and renewal milestones.

raj_platform: Uploaded load profile and metrics dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/aether-prime

maya_cs: Action items: (1) raj — attach final k6 script and quotas (2) sophia — confirm routing policies (3) elliot — create alerts and oncall doc. Will update customer.

loadtest-bot: k6 run started by raj_platform at 2024-07-21T17:10:00Z (out.json streaming).
